verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit docs describe a development environment for GPU-accelerated applications in enterprise data centers, and the HPC SDK page cites CUDA-based HPC applications. Hands-on evidence of a production Llama 405B API running on H200 SXM, plus the note that the H200 shares the H100 (Hopper) die, implies the part works with the CUDA toolchain. However, nothing in the pack shows CUDA documentation explicitly naming H200 as a supported target. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA support or compute-capability listing for H200, and toolkit release notes naming the part.
